title: CITY
description: The lead track 'CITY' from Ai Furihata's debut mini-album 'Moonrise' is now available for pre-release streaming.

title: Moonrise [Limited Edition]
description: Ai Furihata weaves her own lyrics for all songs, expressing her unique vision of love. This debut mini-album contains 6 tracks in total. Akimitsu Honma composed and arranged all the songs. As a first-press bonus, a ticket for the fastest pre-sale lottery application for a special live concert to be held in November 2020 will be included. This will be a strictly limited edition release on analog record (LP). The jacket will feature a newly taken photograph of Ai Furihata.

title: Moonrise [First Press Limited Edition]
description: Ai Furihata weaves her own lyrics for all songs, expressing her unique vision of love. This debut mini-album contains 6 tracks in total. Akimitsu Honma composed and arranged all the songs. The limited edition comes with a Blu-ray & Photobook and a slipcase. The Blu-ray includes the music video for the lead track 'CITY', as well as the 'CITY' music video (Band edition) and making-of footage. The photobook is a luxurious 20-page collection of newly shot photos. As a first-press bonus, it includes a ticket for the fastest pre-sale lottery application for tickets to a special live concert to be held in November 2020. The jackets for the limited edition and the regular edition feature illustrations that evoke 80's city pop, and they connect when placed side by side.

title: Moonrise [Regular Edition]
description: Ai Furihata weaves together different forms of love with lyrics written entirely by herself. This debut mini-album contains 6 tracks in total. Akimitsu Honma composed and arranged all the songs. As a first-press bonus, a ticket for the fastest pre-sale lottery application for a special live concert to be held in November 2020 is included. The jackets of the limited edition and regular edition feature illustrations that evoke 80's city pop and connect when placed side by side.

title: Purple Eyeshadow
description: The lead track 'Purple Eyeshadow' from Ai Furihata's 2nd mini-album 'Makeup' is now available for pre-release streaming.

title: Makeup [First Press Limited Edition]
description: This is the second mini-album following her debut mini-album which featured authentic 80s songs. Once again, Furihata herself wrote the lyrics, and Akimitsu Honma produced, composed, and arranged all the songs. It includes six tracks in total, including the lead track 'Purple Eyeshadow' and 'Midwinter Sheer Mind'. This album is packed with the authentic 80s city pop sound that has become synonymous with Furihata. The first-press limited edition comes with a Blu-ray & Photobook and a slipcase. The photobook is a luxurious 20-page collection of newly shot photos. As a first-press bonus, it includes a ticket for the fastest pre-sale lottery application for tickets to the special live concert to be held in February 2021 and a ticket for the fastest pre-sale lottery application for tickets to the 1st Live Tour to be held in April 2021.

title: Makeup [Regular Edition]
description: This is the second mini-album following her debut mini-album which featured authentic 80s songs. Once again, Furihata herself wrote the lyrics, and Akimitsu Honma handled the production, composition, and arrangement of all tracks. It includes six songs in total, including the lead track 'Purple Eyeshadow' and 'Midwinter Sheer Mind'. This album is packed with the authentic 80s city pop sound that has become synonymous with Furihata. As a first-press bonus, it includes a ticket for the fastest pre-sale lottery application for tickets to the special live show to be held in February 2021 and a ticket for the fastest pre-sale lottery application for tickets to the 1st Live Tour to be held in April 2021.

title: AXIOM [Limited quantity production edition]
description: Ai Furihata is releasing her first 7-inch single record as a strictly limited edition release. This release features two authentic 80s-style songs, with lyrics written by Furihata herself and music composed, arranged, and produced by Akimitsu Honma. The A-side, 'AXIOM', is a spacey track written specifically for her 'Ai Furihata 1st Live Tour APOLLO' in April. The B-side features the upbeat spring song, 'Ushirogami Hikarete'. Both tracks will be available for pre-release streaming on April 11th, ahead of the live performances. The 7-inch single record comes with a circular cushion and will be sold at each venue of the 'Ai Furihata 1st Live Tour APOLLO'.

title: Ai Furihata 1st Live Tour APOLLO at Zepp DiverCity(TOKYO) [Blu-ray]
description: The Blu-ray of Ai Furihata's first live tour , which kicked off on April 18th (Sun) at KT Zepp Yokohama, followed by performances at Zepp Nagoya on April 21st (Wed), Zepp Osaka Bayside on April 24th (Sat), and Zepp DiverCity (TOKYO) on April 29th (Thu/Holiday), will be released on September 29th, 2021 (Wed)! The Blu-ray will include live footage from the tour final at Zepp DiverCity (TOKYO), as well as behind-the-scenes footage of studio rehearsals and the actual performance.

title: Secret Sugar
description: Available on various music streaming sites from 0:00 on Saturday, June 19th .

title: Honeymoon [First Press Limited Edition]
description: Ai Furihata, celebrating her first anniversary since her CD debut, is releasing her long-awaited 1st single. Once again, Furihata wrote the lyrics for all the songs, with Akimitsu Honma handling production, composition, and arrangement. The single contains six tracks in total, including the wedding song 'Secret Sugar', which has been available for streaming since June 19th (Saturday), two new songs, and instrumental versions of each. First-press editions include a lottery application ticket for a backstage invitation to the 'Ai Furihata 2nd Live Tour 'ATTENTION PLEASE!'' starting in October 2021, and a secret keyword for Ai Furihata's official fan club, 'AI OPENER'.
